"Heartless" is a song by American rapper Kanye West from his fourth studio album, 808s & Heartbreak (2008).
The song was written by West, No I.D., Kid Cudi, and Malik Yusef, while being produced by the former two.
It was passed on to West during recording sessions, after originally being intended for inclusion on Jay-Z's eleventh studio album, The Blueprint 3 (2009).
